title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. translated_title: 面向小语言模型更结构化医学解释的自奖励强化学习
translated_abstract: 小语言模型（SLM）可以在普通硬件上运行，并支持保护隐私的本地化临床部署，但与大型语言模型相比，其生成的医学解释往往简短且结构欠佳。近期的监督式方法（如 Meerkat）将思维链推理迁移到 7B-8B 参数规模的骨干模型中，但其训练目标并未直接针对所生成解释的风格或组织结构。基于指令微调的 Mistral-7B 骨干模型，我们研究了轻量级的强化学习（RL）步骤能否在无需人工偏好标注的情况下改善解释的结构。我们在 2,000 个源自 Meerkat 的医学提示上应用了结合 LoRA 适配的近端策略优化（PPO），并由一个简单的自监督奖励引导，该奖励偏好更长、词汇更丰富且标点规范的回答，同时惩罚过短的回答。在单个 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上训练约 170 个 PPO 步骤后，得到了（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需人工偏好标注的自奖励强化学习方法，通过简单的自监督奖励引导 PPO 训练，显著改善了小语言模型生成的医学解释的结构与质量。
